summary: This beginner guide for Dragonheir Season 1 Temporal Vortex explains boss mechanics, skill timing setups, and team compositions. Gorax demonstrates how a free-to-play friendly Frost team can achieve over 3 million damage and reach S rank (1M damage required) without spending skill scrolls recklessly. The guide details how boss skills occur on a fixed 20-second cycle and how to adjust first cast and recast times for supports to mitigate heavy single-target and AoE damage.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Provides healing and debuff immunity; position him behind your main tank to maintain survivability.

heroes.name: Synarell
heroes.note: Built with high max HP to draw the boss's single-target attack and provide team invincibility.

heroes.name: Felosia
heroes.note: Can replace Synarell in Temporal Vortex, though skill timing numbers will need adjustment.

heroes.name: Rava
heroes.verdict: Key debuffer in F2P Frost teams
heroes.note: Equipped with Defense Penalty artifacts like Witch's Remains to boost team damage.

heroes.name: Olgan
heroes.note: Provides steady Frost synergy and Attack buffs to amplify overall team DPS.

heroes.name: Usha
heroes.note: Serves as primary damage dealer; prioritize Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Attack stats.

teams.note: Beginner F2P Frost team using two supports (tank + healer) and three DPS/debuff heroes with 20-second recast skill timings.

tips: Take advantage of free skill resets available during the first 7 days of a new server, but watch the timer so you do not lose skill scrolls.
Ensure your tank hero has the highest max HP on the team to absorb the boss's high single-target 'Call of Lightning' attack.
Align support hero ultimate recast times to 20 seconds to synchronize invincibility and immunity with the boss's fixed attack loop.
Utilize 10 daily combat simulations to test gear tweaks and skill timing adjustments without consuming official battle attempts.
